profile.ja: 水城ゆきかぜの母親。最強の対魔忍・井河アサギの右腕として五車黎明期を支え、“幻影不知火”と呼ばれる武勇智謀に長けた対魔忍であった。水遁の術使いの中でも非常に珍しい、水を操り幻影を成す“幻影陣”の使い手。旧姓は藤林という水遁の術使いを輩出する名家。５年前、ある任務中に行方不明になった。現在は淫魔族のもとで先代の王から死の力を引き継ぎ、魔界を支配する9つの有力貴族の一角“幻夢卿”となっている。
profile.en: Mizuki Yukikaze's mother. As the right hand of the strongest Taimanin, Igawa Asagi, she supported the dawn of the Gosha era, known as the "Phantom Shiranui" for her prowess in both combat and strategy. Among water-style users, she uniquely wielded the "Phantom Formation" that manipulates water into illusions. Her maiden name was Fujibayashi, a famed family of water-style ninjas. She vanished five years ago during a mission. Now, under the succubi, she inherited the death power from the previous king and has become one of the nine powerful nobles ruling the Demon Realm, titled "Kamadeva."

text.ja: あら、見つかってしまったわね。あけましておめでとう。何かご褒美をあげないといけないかしら。坊やは、私に何をしてほしい？
text.en: Oh, you've found me, huh. Happy New Year. I guess I should give you a reward. Boy, what do you want me to do?

text.ja: 坊やが充実しているようでよかったわ。少しだけ、心配だったのよ。いけない素質を目覚めさせてないかね
text.en: I'm glad the boy seems fulfilled. I was a little worried. I hope I haven't awakened any forbidden potential.

text.ja: 綺麗？　ふふっ、そんなことを言われるのも……こんな気持ちで受け取るのも、どのくらいぶりかしら
text.en: Pretty? Hehe, being told that… and feeling it… I wonder how long it's been since I felt like this.

text.ja: 初詣だもの、おみくじでも引いてみましょうか。それとも、おみくじじゃなくて私の帯を引いてみる？　クス、大吉かもね
text.en: Since it's New Year's, shall we draw an omikuji? Or maybe you should draw my obi instead? Heh, could be great luck.

text.ja: 魔女？　こ～ら、今は“お姉さん”って言ったでしょう。今、この夢幻の中でだけはね
text.en: Witch? Hey, I said "big sister" just now. Only in this dreamlike realm, okay?

text.ja: はあぁ～、お神酒で酔っちゃったかも……たった一口で、って？　夢の中でくらい、酔ってもいいでしょう？
text.en: Haah~ I might've gotten drunk on the sacred sake… just one sip, you say? Even in a dream, a little intoxication's fine, right?

text.ja: 新年あけましておめでとう。今年もよろしくお願い……できるといいわね、坊や
text.en: Happy New Year. I hope we can get along this year… that would be nice, boy.

text.ja: どうかしらこの晴れ着。こぼれそう？　だって、こうでもしないと身体に合わないんだもの
text.en: How about this formal wear? Does it look like it'll spill? Because unless I do this, it won't fit my body.

text.ja: あらあら、こんなにおちんちん膨らませて期待しちゃって。またあのいやらしい夢が見たいのね
text.en: Oh dear, you're getting your little thing all swollen with anticipation. You want to see that lewd dream again, don't you?

text.ja: クスクスッ、また女に戻ってしまったの？　いいわ、お姉さんが何度でも、おちんちんに男の子を、思い出させてあげる
text.en: Heh, turned back into a woman again? Fine then, I'll have my big sister remind that cock what a boy is, over and over.

text.ja: あぁあ、悪い子ね……この私のオマンコも子宮も、こんなに疼かせるなんて……戻れなくしてア・ゲ・ル♪
text.en: Ah, you naughty girl… even my pussy and womb are throbbing like this… I'll make you never want to go back, A-G-E-R-U♪
